transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

Well, I'm here because... everyone keeps saying I’ve been doing too much lately. But to me, it just feels like I’m the only one with enough drive to actually get things done. 

I mean, we've got a move to handle, and I need to make sure the new garage is rebuilt right. Plus I'm organizing some things over at the church, and... well, I'm still working, showing the younger fellows down at the mixing plant how the job actually ought to be done. I'm just taking care of business, but my family insisted I come see you.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt unusually down, depressed, or lost interest in your normal activities for weeks at a time?

No, I can't say I have. I mean, sure, everyone has a bad day here and there, especially at my age, but... no, not for weeks at a time. I've always been a worker. I don't have time to sit around moping or losing interest in things. There's always something that needs fixing or sorting out. So, no, I haven't had anything like that.
Have you ever had another time in your life before this when you felt unusually energized, active, or full of drive like you do now?

No, not really. I mean, I've always been a hard worker—you have to be in my line of work—but... no, I can't think of a time where I felt unusually energized or anything like that before. 

I just feel like there's a lot that needs doing right now with the move and the church, and I've got the energy to handle it. But as far as another specific time in the past where I felt like this... no, I don't recall anything like that.
Have you experienced any new physical health problems or medical conditions recently?

No, my health is fine. I haven't had any new problems or anything like that. I mean, I'm 74, so there's the usual wear and tear from working at the plant all my life, but... no new medical conditions. Honestly, I feel strong right now. My body is keeping up with everything I need to get done just fine.
Has this increased energy and activity caused any serious problems or disruptions in your daily life or work?

Well, I suppose... yeah, it has caused some problems. I mean, I ended up getting pulled from work recently. There was a safety incident at the plant, and they told me I needed to step away for a bit. And then at home... things have been tense. My wife and the rest of the family, they kind of stopped trusting me with things. Like making decisions about money, or driving, or even the plans for the move. They said things had just gotten out of hand with me trying to do so much all at once. So, yeah, it has disrupted things, even if I feel like I'm just trying to get it all done.

Have you felt that you have special powers, abilities, or a unique mission that other people don't understand?

No, no... nothing like that. I don't think I have any special powers or a secret mission or anything. I'm just a regular guy. I know I've been doing a lot—maybe trying to do too much, like my family says—but it's just normal stuff, you know? Just trying to get the move sorted out and handle my business. I don't think I'm Superman or anything.
